groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Strong Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.458% and the 10Y at 4.835%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -4.64% over five sessions and -3.55% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +4.10% at about $98.50, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is strong negative (-47/100, 88% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is supportive options positioning on the supportive side versus weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, Nasdaq breadth is weak, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is -6.49% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -47/100 (Strong Negative). Score path: pre-market -22 → now -47; open -42 → now -47 (deteriorated 5 points).

The main live drivers are The 2Y rate signal is supportive: 4.458% (-12.3 bp vs prev close). Rates are mixed: the 10Y is 4.835%, -1.4 bp since the opening snapshot. Semiconductors are a headwind: Previous regular-session close · SOX -12.25% | Nasdaq -5.52% | SOX vs Nasdaq -6.73 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq -7.27 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq -5.69 pp.
